OBJECTIVES: To assess the accuracy of vaginal pH measurement on wet mount microscopy slides compared with direct measurements on fresh vaginal fluid. We also tested whether differences in accuracy were dependent on the sampling devices used or on the diagnosis of the vaginal infections.

Values were compared by Fisher exact and Student's t-tests.

RESULTS: pH measurement from microscopy slides after the addition of saline causes systematic increases of pH leading to false positive readings.
